summary.text: Te Brown is the Republican nominee for Florida's 24th Congressional District. She describes herself as a businesswoman, former teacher and real estate developer running as a political outsider. Her campaign emphasizes school choice, affordable housing, lower costs and limited government.

paragraphs.text: Says she grew up in Chicago and built a real estate development and small business career from a young age.

Her campaign website gives her name as Te Mayonna Brown and describes her as a businesswoman, educator and real estate developer who says she has worked on affordable housing and economic investment in neighborhoods.
Describes herself as a former teacher who supports school choice.
Describes herself as a homeschooling mother.
Says she is not a career politician; won the Republican nomination for the November 3, 2026 general election.
